=== Day 3: the town meeting ===
Agnes: "It troubles me to say it, neighbors, yet I don't trust Dorian. Constance saw them out at night where someone was killed."
Agnes: "Before Isolde died, they told me they were the Lamplighter, and that the night before you arrived walking the lamps, they counted 1 other out."  [case board: #81, #82]
Dorian: "I didn't want to say this, sorry. I'm Ill-Omened. Hanging me would cost the town."
Dorian: "I hate speaking up like this, really, yet I don't trust Edda. My own records tie them to the Poisoner."  [case board: #83, #26]
Edda: "Agnes has the right of it about Dorian, friends."  [case board: #84]
Jory: "Look, I gotta say it—I don't trust Constance! My own reading says the people living on the Square aren't all on one side, and they live there."  [case board: #85]
Constance: "I should mention: Last night, I watched the Docks: I saw Dorian out."
Constance: "I concur with Agnes regarding Dorian. My own reading pointed at them."  [case board: #86, #87]
Greta: "I'll put my cards on the table so the rest of you stop squinting at me: I am the Dowser."
Greta: "On the first day, in the morning, on the Market I sensed 0 evil among Hollis and Isolde."
Greta: "On the second day, in the morning, on the Market I sensed 1 evil among Hollis and Agnes."
Greta: "This afternoon, on the Docks I sensed 2 evil among Jory, Constance, Edda, Agnes."  [case board: #88, #89, #90, #91]
